title: IVM Bytecode
summary: The compiled Kotodama program format in SORA Nexus (.to files) containing headers, ABI versions, and vector tables that the IVM loads and executes deterministically.
definition: The compiled Kotodama program format in SORA Nexus (.to files) containing headers, ABI versions, and vector tables that the IVM loads and executes deterministically.
tagline: Provides a portable, versioned format for smart contracts that guarantees identical execution across all validators regardless of hardware or operating system.
